svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Calibri, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Grant Pathway: high-level process overview
svg.desc: Set up once, then five steps: application details, funder guidelines, plain-English summary, your answers, review and export. If the charity is not eligible, Grant Pathway says so at step 3 and stops the application. Key principles: free for small and mid-size UK charities; AI assists but the charity is always the author; content is stored in the UK and never sold or used to train AI models; Grant Pathway never submits an application.
svg.text: AI assistance. Your voice. Always free.

text.tspan: Register a free account and create your charity profile — you only do this once.

svg.text: Enter your charity registration number and Grant Pathway can fill in some details from the public register.

text.tspan: A final check, then a clean

svg.text: Not eligible for this grant? Grant Pathway says so at Step 3 and stops there.
Better to know in five minutes than after a weekend of writing.

g.text: Free for small and mid-size UK charities — no subscription, no tiers
AI assists with structure and clarity; the charity is always the author
Your content is stored in the UK. Never sold, never used to train AI models
Grant Pathway never submits — you review and send it to the funder yourself
